response.query: How many items per class are required for robust detector-evaluation (AUROC/power) and what are pilot sample recommendations?
response.answer: For robust detector evaluation (AUROC/power), at least 30 items per class are typically required. Pilot samples should include 10-20 items per class to assess initial performance.
